name: GetManyBusinessServices
label: Get Many Business Services
description: Retrieves multiple Business Services from ServiceNow using a stored credential. Supports pagination.

fields.name: CredentialId
fields.label: Credential
fields.description: Select the stored ServiceNow credential by ID

fields.name: ReturnAll
fields.label: Return All
fields.description: If enabled, retrieves all business services across all pages. If disabled, only returns up to 'Limit' records from the first page.

fields.name: Limit
fields.label: Limit
fields.description: Maximum number of business services to retrieve per request (used when Return All is off). Max: 1000.

fields.name: Response
fields.label: API Response
fields.description: Raw JSON response from the last page (or first if error)

fields.name: BusinessServices
fields.label: Business Services
fields.description: List of business service records (sys_id, name, etc.)

fields.name: TotalCount
fields.label: Total Count
fields.description: Total number of business services retrieved
